title: Configure wesnoth
description: Configure the Battle for Wesnoth server module

game_port.title: Game port
game_port.description: TCP port published on the node for the Wesnoth clients (default 15000).

admin_password.title: Administrator password
admin_password.description: Password for /query admin commands from a client. Empty: keep the current one.

admin_password_clear.title: Remove the administrator password
admin_password_clear.description: Disables admin login from clients (the console on the settings page still works).

versions_accepted.title: Accepted client versions
versions_accepted.description: Comma separated patterns (* and ? wildcards), e.g. 1.18.*. Empty: every version of the server's stable series.

disallow_names.title: Disallowed nicknames
disallow_names.description: Patterns with * and ? wildcards; empty list = wesnothd defaults.
